ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.

CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.

PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN ENGINEER'S REPORT FOR LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 ANNUAL ASSESSMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
RES 2017-15 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVINGTHE ENGINEER'S REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LOMITA'S LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-18.
ACTION: That the City Council after conducting a public hearing, adopt the resolution approving the Engineer's Report for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2017-18.

PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF A PROPOSED ORDINANCE AMENDING PENALTY AMOUNTS AND TERMINATION OF NONCONFORMING STATUS
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 789 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 6-8.06(A); WHEREBY INCREASING FINE AMOUNTS FOR MASSAGE ORDINANCE VIOLATIONS, AND SECTION 11-1.07.17(B)4; IN REGARDS TO TERMINATING NONCONFORMING MASSAGE BUSINESSES WHICH OPERATE WITHOUT THE REQUIRED LICENSES. (Initiated by the City of Lomita) First Reading
ACTION: That after the City Attorney reads title of the ordinance, introduce on first reading of an ordinance amending Section 6-8.06(A); whereby increasing fine amounts for massage ordinance violations; and Section 11-1.70.17(B)4; in regards to terminating nonconforming massage businesses which operate without the required licenses; and that said ordinance be scheduled for second reading for June 6, 2016.
Item #9

10.
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF AN AGREEMENT TO PALP INC. DBA EXCEL PAVING COMPANY FOR NARBONNE AVENUE PAVEMENT REHABILITATON
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: That the City Council approve approve the following:
1.
Approve the plans and specification for the Narbonne Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation Project; and
2.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Palp Inc., dba Excel Paving Company in the amount of $1,019.007.07 for the construction of the project; and
3.
Approve the total budget of $1,120,908.47 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions) for the Agreement; and
4.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement.

11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting adjourn to Wednesday, May 17, 2017 at 4:45 p.m. for a budget workshop to be held at the Don Knabe Community Room, 24200 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
